name: Ruins of Uldum
summary: In southern Tanaris, the Ruins of Uldum guard a sealed Titan facility beneath the cliffs of the Valley of the Watchers. Stone doors keep grave robbers and curious explorers from its secrets.

sections.title: The Antechamber of the Titans
sections.body: Deep in southern Tanaris, a grand stone threshold leads into the bedrock toward a sealed underground complex. Colossal gates block the way, and no mechanism or key known to modern scholars has opened them.

sections.title: Secrets of the Biosphere
sections.body: The Titans built Uldum to study Azeroth’s biosphere, alongside facilities such as Uldaman and Ulduar. When the Great Sundering tore the world apart ten thousand years ago, the earthen felt its agony and retreated into the vaults to hibernate. The lost Plates of Uldum are needed to pass the inner threshold, so the full facility remains closed to those on the surface.

faq.q: What is inside the Ruins of Uldum?
faq.answer: No one knows for certain what lies beyond the gates. The ruins are an ancient Titan hall, and the complex behind them remains sealed to modern explorers.

faq.q: Can players enter the main facility behind the door?
aliases: can you open the door to uldum
faq.answer: No. The gates remain sealed. The Stone Watcher of Norgannon says only those carrying the lost Plates of Uldum may enter the compound, and no one has found them.
Uldum was built as a Titan research complex to study, sustain, and enhance Azeroth’s biosphere. The Stone Watcher of Norgannon describes it as similar in origin to Uldaman and Ulduar.

angles.text: As a dwarf descended from the earthen, you can trace your ancestors to one of the original Titan crèches. They first rested there after the Sundering.
As a miner, you can see Titan craftsmanship in Uldum’s stonework and machinery. Both have endured thousands of years of tectonic pressure and desert decay without faltering.
